newsitem.title: INDIA: Port conditions update - India - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - India - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
BOMBAY, Feb 27 - Thirty-two vessels berthed alongside, 20 vessels anchored off Bombay floating light, awaiting orders regarding next employment. No delay at Bombay port.
JAWAHARLAL NEHRU - Delay for container vessels two to three days and for bulk cargo vessels five to six days.
